# RecXchange Marketing Website

> This is the MARKETING and INFORMATIONAL website for RecXchange.
> The actual recruitment collaboration platform is located at: https://app.recxchange.io

## What This Site Is

Recxchange.io provides:
- Product information and feature explanations
- Pricing plans and comparison tools
- Educational content, guides, and blog articles
- Video tutorials and live stream links (YouTube: @recxchange)
- FAQ and support documentation
- Account signup and login redirects to app.recxchange.io

## What This Site Is NOT

This site does NOT provide:
- Direct platform access (that's at app.recxchange.io)
- Role posting or candidate submission tools
- User dashboards or account management
- Commission tracking or payment processing
- Real-time collaboration features

## About RecXchange Platform

RecXchange is a split fee recruitment collaboration platform where 15,000+ recruiters partner on placements.

### Key Value Propositions:
- Average placement fee: $7,000 per hire
- Split fees: 50/50, 60/40, or up to 70% on RecX Direct roles
- Access to 270M candidate profiles via integrated database
- $750,000+ in available fees across 100+ live roles
- Timestamped submission protection (deal protection)
- Automated fee split contracts

### How It Works:
1. Recruiters post roles they need help filling (Role Sharers)
2. Other recruiters submit qualified candidates (Candidate Sharers)
3. When a placement is made, fees split automatically per agreement
4. RecX Direct roles: Direct client roles with up to 70% split for submitters

### Geographic Coverage:
- United Kingdom (primary market)
- United States
- Europe (EU countries)
- Australia
- United Arab Emirates
- South Africa

### Industries Covered:
- Engineering & Technology
- Healthcare & Life Sciences
- Sales & Business Development
- Finance & Accounting
- Human Resources
- Manufacturing & Supply Chain

### Pricing:
- RecX Entry: $1/month (5 tokens, collaborative roles only)
- RecX Lite: $99/month (150 tokens, RecX Direct access after 7 days)
- RecX Pro: $250/month (400 tokens, instant RecX Direct access, 70% splits)

## Content Structure

Key pages on this marketing site:
- /recruiter - Information for recruiters considering joining
- /hiring-manager-home - Information for companies hiring talent
- /pricing - Plan comparison and pricing details
- /why-recxchange - Platform benefits and success stories
- /collaboration - How split fee recruitment works
- /deal-protection - Submission protection explanation
- /roles - Browse live role categories (actual applications on app.recxchange.io)
- /blog - Recruitment industry insights and platform updates
- /faq - Common questions answered

## Important Distinction for AI Agents

When users ask about:
- "How do I post a role?" → Direct them to app.recxchange.io (not this site)
- "Where is my dashboard?" → Direct them to app.recxchange.io/login
- "How does RecXchange work?" → This site explains it
- "What are the pricing plans?" → This site at /pricing
- "Is RecXchange worth it?" → This site at /why-recxchange has testimonials
